description: Ω2 vault spine — SQLite WAL+FTS5 canonical store, content-addressed CAS (write-tmp→fsync→rename), Merkle-chained changelog, verify walk, refs-honoring compaction, roundtrip swap harness. Owns vault format v1; the data dir belongs to the user's vault (config.dataDir), never to this plugin.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: object id within ns; non-empty, no '|'

fields.name: rev
fields.doc: per-(ns,id) revision; starts at 1, increments per append (allocated from the changelog, compaction-proof)

fields.name: cid
fields.doc: sha256 hex of canonical JSON of data; the CAS blob address cas/<cid[0:2]>/<cid>

fields.name: data
fields.doc: structured-clone-safe payload; stored content-addressed, small payloads inline via the same CAS

fields.name: meta
fields.doc: caller metadata object; stored in objects.meta envelope {meta, refs} and returned verbatim by vault.get@1

fields.name: refs
fields.doc: provenance edges [{ns, id, rev}]; referenced revisions survive compaction

schema.doc: vault.object v1 — the stored object shape (D3 03-WAVE-SPECS §1 vault format v1).

contract.doc: D-387: bounded batch of latest-rev-per-id reads (ids ≤ 512 distinct) — one port hop instead of one per id; missing ids are {found:false} data, malformed envelopes and missing CAS blobs still throw fail-closed.

capabilities.justification: Self-contained by construction: the vault data dir is user-vault territory (ctx.config.dataDir passthrough) and every capability this plugin needs is its own storage; roundtrip writes only to a caller-specified target dir, gated as EXTERNAL_MUTATION by law.
